statements.headline: Hazardous Weather Outlook
statements.summary: This afternoon and tonight. The risk for localized flooding will slowly lover through tonight as high pressure builds to the north. Until then, a locally heavy rain shower/thunderstorm may still develop and increase the risk of flash flooding.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: This afternoon and tonight. The risk for localized flooding will slowly lover through tonight as high pressure builds to the north. Until then, a locally heavy rain shower/thunderstorm may still develop and increase the risk of flash flooding.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Friday through Wednesday. The potential for multiple periods of showers and thunderstorms within another warm, moist environment could result in varying degrees of flash flood risks Saturday into early next week.
